changelog:
Initial release of lygo-fractalweaver:
- Transforms fractal or self-similar images into evolving audio textures using the LYGO RESONANCE engine.
- Analyzes fractal properties (dimension, self-similarity, iteration depth, branching) to extract audio-mapping parameters.
- Generates high-quality stereo WAVs (and optional MIDI/stems) with recursive, organic evolution based on the visual pattern.
- Supports batch processing, reproducibility with seeds, and direct integration with LYGO Agent, Resonance, and Ollama workflow.
- Output includes a detailed profile JSON describing the fractal-derived evolution, suitable for chaining or advanced creative workflows.
